title: CodeMaster tracker config (.codemaster/config.json)
description: Per-project selection of the backlog tracker provider and its settings.

tracker.description: Which provider implements the tracker verbs.

verify.description: The project's own green-check command, run by build (every loop) and ship (final gate) — e.g. 'npm test && npm run lint'. Set by /codemaster-init; build and ship stop if it's missing.

root.description: Backlog root relative to the repo, e.g. '.codemaster/backlog'. Gitignored in its entirety. Holds items/<id>-<slug>/{item.json, <doc-slot>.md} — one flat folder per item.

idPrefix.description: Uppercase id prefix, e.g. 'ETK'. Every item's id is <idPrefix>-<n>, at every level.

plane.description: Settings for the `plane` provider (REST API via CLI).

envFile.description: Path (repo-relative) to the gitignored env file with PLANE_API_URL / PLANE_API_KEY / PLANE_WORKSPACE_SLUG.

statusMap.description: Maps CodeMaster status -> the provider's native state (for remote providers, a Plane state group). Identity for the folder provider.

blocked.description: Omit for the `plane` provider — Plane has no `blocked` state group; it models blocked as a label. /codemaster-init --check flags it if present.
